notes: New: Finance > Business: money in and out for each business you run, with In, Out and Profit at the top for this month, last month, the quarter or the tax year; Service, product, or both: the screens and categories follow. Invoices and quotes (numbered for you, PDF or text), products and stock, customers, people and pay, mileage and documents; Bring money in from a bank statement (CSV or Excel) or pasted rows: the ones you already have are left out and categories are guessed; Scan a receipt: the total, date and shop are read on your PC at home (free, private), for you to check; Run a business with a partner: invite a friend, choose what they can do, and they see only that business; Reports for your accountant (profit and loss, lists, a year-end pack) and tax, VAT and mileage estimates from gov.uk figures you can change; A bank feed for business accounts through the PC at home (needs setting up there first). Fixed: Opening a bill or invoice from a link could show the one before it
